tasks.label: Setup: Dev Environment
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-Path .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe)) { python -m venv .venv }; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

tasks.label: Tests: Coordinator Logic
tasks.command: if (Test-Path .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_coordinator_logic.py } else { python -m pytest tests/test_coordinator_logic.py }

tasks.label: Tests: All
tasks.command: if (Test-Path .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests } else { python -m pytest tests }
